sentences.en: Situated on a hill, his house commands a fine view.
sentences.zh: 他的房子坐落在山上，可以俯瞰美景。

sentences.en: Nikko is situated about seventy five miles north of Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 日光位于东京北部约七十五英里处。

sentences.en: Her house is situated in the neighborhood of the park.
sentences.zh: 她的房子靠近公园附近。

senses.zh: 使位于；使处于（situate的过去分词）
